exports.name: Knowledge manifest
exports.description: Inspect Knowledge's packaged export IDs; invoke only tools present in the enabled tool catalog. Agent workflow: search/read existing project knowledge, store readable anchored Requirements, Specification and Media artifacts, use documents for reports/context, re-read on resume, then record verified evidence. Other plugins are not enabled by this manifest.

exports.name: Preview Knowledge transfer
exports.description: Read-only preview of eligible artifact copies into explicit destination project_root. Review source_project_root, source_artifact_id, target_semantic_element_id, exact_match/simhash_distance and already_copied before selecting transfer_ids. Content fingerprints indicate similarity, not project identity or permission; indexing does not apply transfers automatically.

exports.name: Apply selected Knowledge transfer
exports.description: Apply only reviewed transfer_ids from a fresh preview for explicit destination project_root. Revalidates eligibility and destination scope before freezing one atomic selected dependency set; source artifacts remain. Copies preserve provenance, referenced attachments and eligible structured references. Keep operation_id for identical retries: replay returns the original full result before mutable eligibility checks. A fresh review uses a new operation_id; stale competing publications conflict. Completed copies are kept. copied_artifact_ids/already_copied_artifact_ids contain exact accepted artifact IDs, not review choices. Preview similarity is not project identity.

anyOf.description: Keep this ID when retrying the same reviewed selection; use a new ID after a fresh review.

exports.name: List Knowledge dependents
exports.description: List artifacts with explicit dependency edges to target_kind/target_id (semantic_element or artifact). Verify returned project scope and inspect affected records before a change; an empty list says nothing about undocumented dependencies.

exports.name: Create Knowledge
exports.description: Search with search_knowledge/get_knowledge before creating; update an existing record when appropriate. Supply project_root and the narrowest existing semantic_element_id. Use plain titles/content and human-readable Markdown for someone outside this agent conversation: purpose/outcome first, plain language, complete sentences, short paragraphs. Separate headings, lists and paragraphs with blank lines. Explain decisions and why they matter; fence code/log excerpts; place raw IDs in metadata or labeled links. Avoid terse agent shorthand. Kinds: requirements for expected outcomes/acceptance criteria, specification for design/constraints, media for image/audio/video notes. Reports, reference notes, plans, handoffs and questions use create_document (Context). Agents owns executable missions, status, owner, blockers and evidence. Optional expires_at (RFC 3339) ends active discovery. New records start active at revision 1. Retain returned artifact_id as its exact accepted revision. Reuse operation_id with identical retry input; choose a new ID for a later action. No atomic lease/claim guarantee.

anyOf.description: Keep this ID when retrying one action; use a new ID for a later intentional action. Omitted: identical requests replay.

metadata.description: Optional. A media artifact may pin anchor_selector: kind image_region with x, y, width, height as 0-1 fractions, or kind audio_segment or video_segment with start_seconds and end_seconds.

exports.name: Update Knowledge
exports.description: Use search_knowledge/get_knowledge first; preserve human text. Pass project_root, artifact_id and expected_revision from the original read. Reuse operation_id/input after a lost reply; on conflict re-read, merge and use a new ID. Working saves keep artifact_id. Element changes, pins and citations freeze history; retain returned IDs. Cite working dependencies with edit_version from get_knowledge. If replay reports knowledge_artifact_edit_unavailable, use get_artifact_write_receipt. Set status resolved when done, superseded with superseded_by when replaced, or archived when withdrawn. Content, tags, dependencies and metadata replace prior values: merge deliberately. Write human-readable Markdown for someone outside this agent conversation: purpose first, plain language, complete sentences, short paragraphs, headings/lists when useful, blank lines between blocks and fenced code/logs. Explain decisions; keep raw IDs in metadata/labeled links. Avoid terse agent shorthand. Complete only after acceptance criteria are verified; record commands/results and remaining limits. Updates offer no atomic lease/claim guarantee.

anyOf.description: Keep this ID when retrying one action; use a new ID for a later intentional action, including after restoring history. Omitted: identical requests replay.

exports.name: Delete Knowledge
exports.description: Remove the exact current artifact revision from its selection with explicit project_root and expected_revision from its original read matching its stored scope; retained historical bodies are not destroyed. Keep operation_id and input unchanged when retrying the same removal. Prefer a status change (resolved, superseded or archived) when the history should stay. Read it first and inspect dependents. Preserve human guidance unless removal is intended.

anyOf.description: Keep this ID when retrying one removal; use a new ID for a later intentional action.

exports.name: Get Knowledge
exports.description: Read the full artifact by artifact_id after search/list discovery. This ID-only request has no project_root field: verify the returned artifact's project_root and semantic anchor match the current checkout. The record carries status, revision and timestamps. Exact IDs may address retained history even when status is active; choose current revisions through project search/list before editing. An inactive record is not a current instruction. Reconcile requirements and specifications with current source/tests before resuming; saved completion text alone is not verification. Read reports and plans through get_document, and mission state through Agents.

exports.name: List Knowledge for element
exports.description: Read artifacts attached to one existing semantic_element_id from the current project. This ID-only request has no project_root field: verify each returned artifact's project_root. Only active records are returned by default; include_inactive: true adds resolved, superseded, archived and expired ones. Inspect nearby requirements and specifications before editing. Read report/context documents separately.

exports.name: List Knowledge
exports.description: List full artifacts with explicit current project_root and optional semantic_element_ids/type/tags/limit. Only active records are returned by default; include_inactive: true adds resolved, superseded, archived and expired ones. Review nearby requirements and specifications before creating duplicates; a result limit can omit records.

exports.name: Search Knowledge
exports.description: Search readable project knowledge with explicit current project_root and optional narrow semantic_element_id/type filters before creating or changing a record. Only active records are returned by default; include_inactive: true adds resolved, superseded, archived and expired ones. Results contain IDs/titles/scores/status, not full content: follow with get_knowledge to restore requirements or specifications. Search reports and context through search_documents. Inspect vector/lexical mode; no result is not proof that related knowledge never existed.

exports.name: Find semantic elements
exports.description: Find semantic owners for a narrow artifact anchor with explicit current project_root. This delegates to compiled Semantic and requires that plugin to be enabled/available; inspect returned IDs rather than inventing an anchor.

exports.name: Get semantic element
exports.description: Read an existing semantic_element_id for anchor inspection. This ID-only request has no project_root field; use an ID already discovered within the current project. The public element view omits project_root, so retain and verify the originating discovery scope.

exports.name: Rebuild Knowledge vectors
exports.description: Rebuild search vectors for existing artifacts with explicit project_root. Inspect returned job status/vectors_rebuilt, including unavailable embedding capability; this does not regenerate source knowledge or prove task completion.

exports.name: Run Knowledge cultivation
exports.description: Run the requested cultivation mode within explicit project_root and optional target_id/target_path. Inspect the returned run.document_ids and canonical Context documents; generated summaries do not replace human acceptance criteria or verified task evidence.

exports.name: Get Knowledge cultivation run
exports.description: Read a stored run by run_id and verify its project_root/mode/document IDs. This ID-only request has no project_root field; a recorded run is not evidence that every generated document or implementation task is complete.

exports.name: Ensure C4 nucleus
exports.description: Ensure a scoped C4 report for explicit project_root and a target_id or target_path. refresh/retry_failed may request generation work; inspect returned pending, failed or held state and read generated documents before relying on them. A held report preserves authored content or an intentional deletion; review its reason_code instead of overwriting or creating a parallel body.

exports.name: Debug C4 nucleus
exports.description: Diagnose a scoped C4 nucleus without mutation using explicit project_root and optional target_id/target_path. Inspect functional Context documents and report state before requesting generation; diagnostics are not task completion.

exports.name: Assistant semantic element read
exports.description: Read an existing semantic_element_id for anchor inspection. This ID-only request has no project_root field; use an ID already discovered within the current project. The public element view omits project_root, so retain and verify the originating discovery scope.

exports.name: Read memory document hook
exports.description: Read the owning Assistant or MCP memory document's maintenance permission and setup state. Ownership comes from the host. Agent-space hooks retain their existing Agent automation interfaces.

exports.name: Configure memory document hook
exports.description: Configure or disable maintenance of an owned Assistant/MCP context or report. Pass the original expected_hook_revision (null for first setup) and stable operation_id. Enabling also requires the original document revision/locator and Agents settings. Exact retries preserve original inputs and intent. Disable requires no source read and fences queued writes immediately. Other workflow ownership is never replaced; human edits hold automatic publication.

settings.description: Agents settings: objective (text), propagation (existing static/dynamic/scheduled rule), optional schedule, optional linked_inputs. Omitted inputs watches all current direct links; [] watches the destination alone. Required when enabled.

exports.name: Resolve caller document space
exports.description: Resolve your host-authorized persistent memory space: MCP callers use purpose current_project; Assistant and agent callers use purpose self. Use the returned project_root with the existing context/report document tools. Memory survives separate conversations and application restarts. Ownership and project restrictions come from the host, never from tool arguments. Unbound caller scopes fail without creating a space.

exports.name: Assistant persistent document space
exports.description: Resolve your host-authorized persistent memory space: MCP callers use purpose current_project; Assistant and agent callers use purpose self. Use the returned project_root with the existing context/report document tools. Memory survives separate conversations and application restarts. Ownership and project restrictions come from the host, never from tool arguments. Unbound caller scopes fail without creating a space.

exports.name: Read qualified document reference
exports.description: Read a source element, Knowledge artifact or document through its authorized project. Selected mode follows that named selection; exact mode never substitutes newer content. The returned reference includes canonical authority and lineage plus the exact observed identity/edit version. Copy it into a qualified document reference to retain evidence on save. A read alone does not pin evidence. Missing and pruned remain explicit; never refresh a saved edit token silently.

exports.name: Assistant qualified reference read
exports.description: Read a source element, Knowledge artifact or document through its authorized project. Selected mode follows that named selection; exact mode never substitutes newer content. The returned reference includes canonical authority and lineage plus the exact observed identity/edit version. Copy it into a qualified document reference to retain evidence on save. A read alone does not pin evidence. Missing and pruned remain explicit; never refresh a saved edit token silently.

exports.name: Create independent document
exports.description: Create an independent project document without a source-file anchor. Supply a stable document_id, project_root, document_kind, title and content. Use report for Markdown reports, context for reference notes, and canvas for Canvas-owned scene content. Optional references cite sources, artifacts or other documents without giving those targets ownership. For a working artifact citation, copy edit_version from the original get_knowledge or list_knowledge read into its reference; stale or missing edit versions fail without saving.

exports.name: Assistant document create
exports.description: Create an independent project document without a source-file anchor. Supply a stable document_id, project_root, document_kind, title and content. Optional references cite sources, artifacts or other documents without giving those targets ownership. For a working artifact citation, copy edit_version from the original get_knowledge or list_knowledge read into its reference; stale or missing edit versions fail without saving.

exports.name: Read independent document
exports.description: Read a document by its discovered document_id and exact project_root. The result includes its independent identity, content, grouping path, optional references and current revision. Read before editing; preserve human text and workflow metadata.

exports.name: Assistant document read
exports.description: Read a document by its discovered document_id and exact project_root. The result includes its independent identity, content, grouping path, optional references and current revision. Read before editing; preserve human text and workflow metadata.

exports.name: Update independent document
exports.description: Update supplied document fields after a fresh get_document. Pass expected_revision and expected_semantic_element_id from that read; stale revisions fail without writing. Unspecified fields remain. Organization path changes do not move source files. Preserve human edits and references; read back to verify a save. Keep each artifact reference edit_version from the originally read body; never refresh it silently while saving.

exports.name: Assistant document update
exports.description: Update supplied document fields after a fresh get_document. Pass expected_revision and expected_semantic_element_id from that read; stale revisions fail without writing. exports.name: List independent documents
exports.description: List independent documents in an exact project, optionally filtered by document_kind, query and include_inactive. Without a project, list accessible source projects and exclude private document spaces. Reports do not need source anchors; private spaces require an explicit authorized scope.

exports.name: Assistant document list
exports.description: List independent documents in an exact project, optionally filtered by document_kind, query and include_inactive. Without a project, list accessible source projects and exclude private document spaces. Reports do not need source anchors; private spaces require an explicit authorized scope.

exports.name: Search document content
exports.description: Return up to 10 relevant independent documents ranked by title, content, grouping path and tags, with a query and optional project/kind scope. Inspect returned mode rather than assuming vector retrieval. Results include standalone reports even when no source element is selected. Use list_documents for a complete inventory.

exports.name: Assistant document search
exports.description: Return up to 10 relevant independent documents ranked by title, content, grouping path and tags, with a query and optional project/kind scope. Inspect returned mode rather than assuming vector retrieval. Results include standalone reports even when no source element is selected. Use list_documents for a complete inventory.

exports.name: Delete independent document
exports.description: Remove the document revision you read in its exact project scope. Pass expected_revision and expected_semantic_element_id from that read; stale deletion fails. Reuse operation_id only for an identical retry. A minimal deletion identity remains; wanted historical content follows retention and pins. Removing a citation target never implicitly deletes another report.

exports.name: Assistant document delete
exports.description: Remove the document revision you read in its exact project scope. Pass expected_revision and expected_semantic_element_id from that read; stale deletion fails. Reuse operation_id only for an identical retry. A minimal deletion identity remains; wanted historical content follows retention and pins. Removing a citation target never implicitly deletes another report.

exports.name: Read document citation retention
exports.description: Inspect source retention for an original document write. Reconciliation releases only this publication's claims after both its exact destination locator and payload are pruned. Current or retained historical documents keep their evidence. Pending writes can replay the identical request; conflicted writes conservatively retain their visible claims. This never discards another citation's claim or enables automatic collection.

exports.name: Reconcile obsolete citation claims
exports.description: Inspect source retention for an original document write. Reconciliation releases only this publication's claims after both its exact destination locator and payload are pruned. Current or retained historical documents keep their evidence. Pending writes can replay the identical request; conflicted writes conservatively retain their visible claims. This never discards another citation's claim or enables automatic collection.

exports.name: Read document write acknowledgement
exports.description: Read a known Knowledge write acknowledgement using a project_root resolving to its original project, the explicit operation_id and original create/update/delete action. Returns progress, exact accepted revision, lifecycle counter and acceptance version without loading retained content, following successors or retrying pending work.

exports.name: Read artifact write acknowledgement
exports.description: Read a known Knowledge write acknowledgement using a project_root resolving to its original project, the explicit operation_id and original create/update/delete action. Returns progress, exact accepted revision, lifecycle counter and acceptance version without loading retained content, following successors or retrying pending work.

exports.name: Prepare captured document maintenance provenance
exports.description: Pure captured-document provenance for Agents maintenance. Inspect body-bound causal paths or prepare metadata for the proposed content. Performs no storage reads or writes and grants no permission; publication still requires the original exact editing base and authority.

exports.name: Inspect persistent memory
exports.description: Native human inspection of one persistent Assistant, Agent or project-shared MCP memory space. Reuses document editing bases and receipts. HTTP/MCP callers cannot acquire this authority.

settings.description: Agents settings: objective (text), propagation (existing static/dynamic/scheduled rule), optional schedule, optional linked_inputs. Omitted inputs watches all current direct links; [] watches the destination alone. Required when enabled.

exports.name: Execute bounded memory maintenance
exports.description: Internal Agents maintenance command. The host binds one enabled permission revision, exact destination and named inputs to the authenticated executor. Content updates require the original editing base and unchanged generated-content ownership; no other documents, source writes or arbitrary exports are granted.

exports.name: Project Knowledge
exports.description: Read the canonical project Knowledge projection using projectRoot and changesSince. Preserve revision/scope when consuming it; Requirements, Specification and Media remain artifacts; Report and Context bodies are documents.

exports.name: Knowledge manifest
exports.description: List indexed project sourceId values for Knowledge HTTP consumers. Select the exact current project root; display names/fingerprints do not identify a project.

exports.name: Knowledge setup
exports.description: Read Obsidian setup metadata for the selected sourceId query scope; this does not create artifacts or enable other plugins.

exports.name: Knowledge projection export
exports.description: Export the selected sourceId project's Knowledge projection through an HTTP envelope. Retain project/revision context for subsequent reads.

exports.name: Knowledge projection page
exports.description: Read one projected element page with sourceId and elementId/element_id query scope; do not confuse document hashes with project identity.

exports.name: Knowledge Obsidian sync
exports.description: Read versioned Obsidian projection changes from a schema-v1 JSON body using sourceId, appliedRevision and contentHashes. Reconcile the returned revision/change batch; it is projection synchronization, not a task ownership claim.

exports.name: Knowledge C4 nucleus
exports.description: HTTP adapter for scoped C4 report generation. Supply current project_root and target_id/target_path in the JSON body, then inspect pending/failed generation before trusting the report.

exports.name: Knowledge C4 action
exports.description: Read the scoped C4 action descriptor; obtaining its method/path/query does not execute generation.

exports.name: Knowledge C4 diagnostics
exports.description: Read scoped C4 diagnostics with project_root and target_id/target_path in the HTTP query without mutation.

exports.name: Knowledge write
exports.description: HTTP create adapter: put the same readable title/content, explicit project_root and existing semantic anchor as create_knowledge in the JSON body; search/read existing records first.

exports.description: HTTP delete adapter: read the artifact first, then supply artifact_id, expected_revision and matching project_root in the JSON body. Inspect dependents before intended removal.

exports.name: Knowledge live events
exports.description: Consume Knowledge live-event pages and retain the returned cursor; this feed is not project-filtered, so verify event/artifact scope. Events prompt a fresh artifact read; they are not a task lease or authoritative completion evidence.

exports.description: Runtime-delivered semantic-change trigger invalidates projections and refreshes report intents. It does not automatically apply cross-project transfers; agents should not fabricate deliveries.

exports.name: Consume generated functional artifacts
exports.description: Recurring runtime consumer stores completed functional Context documents. Inspect pending/completed generation state; it is not an implementation-task scheduler or atomic claim service.
